1.consolidated_definition: fic. Extraterrestre. Ser inteligente procedente de otro planeta, por extensión ser atípico. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Llegan dos fulanas y se me sientan al lado. Pongo mi mejor cara de perro. Al rato son- ríen entre sí. Se saben ante la presencia de un alien ()
1.en_consolidated_definition: Extraterrestrial being. Intelligent being from another planet, by extension an atypical person. Raw anglicism, frequent. They arrive two prostitutes and sit next to me. I put on my best dog face. A while later they laugh between themselves. They're aware of the presence of an alien ().
